faq_items.question_zh: 可以先确认材料和生产规格吗？
faq_items.answer_zh: 可以。请在询价时说明用途和关注的材料规格，我们会根据可供产品确认具体参数及样品安排。
faq_items.question_en: Can I confirm materials and specifications before ordering?
faq_items.answer_en: Tell us the application and the specifications you need to confirm, and we will confirm the available options before you commit. Material samples or a printed proof can be arranged for most media — ask when you request your quotation.

faq_items.question_zh: 没有设计稿，也能制作吗？
faq_items.answer_zh: 可以提供基础文件检查和简单调整；复杂修改或原创设计会另行报价。
faq_items.question_en: Can you help if I do not have print-ready artwork?
faq_items.answer_en: We can provide basic file checks and simple adjustments. Complex revisions or original design work are quoted separately.

faq_items.answer_zh: 我们会根据订单尺寸、重量、包装和目的地协调运输方案，具体费用与交期以项目确认结果为准。
faq_items.question_en: What payment and delivery methods are available?
faq_items.answer_en: Payment is by bank transfer (T/T) against a proforma invoice, so the specification, quantity and total are agreed in writing before you pay. Production time is confirmed in your quotation; sea freight to main Australian ports typically takes around 40 days in transit. Delivery terms and any import charges for your destination are stated in the quotation before you confirm.

faq_items.question_zh: 如何处理印刷质量问题？
faq_items.answer_zh: 生产前会确认文件和规格。如出现影响使用的生产质量问题，请提供照片和订单信息，我们会核实并协商处理方案。
faq_items.question_en: What if there is a print quality issue?
faq_items.answer_en: Files and specifications are confirmed before production, and photos of the finished goods and their export packing are shared with you before dispatch. If a production quality issue still affects use, tell us with photos and order details — we will prioritize reprinting or agree on another appropriate solution.

faq_items.question_zh: 不同产品可以拼单、一起发吗？
faq_items.answer_zh: 可以。不同材料和成品画面通常可以合并为一个订单，适合拼在一起的也可以合并包装、合并发运。询价时请把完整清单（含尺寸和数量）发过来，拼单组合、包装和合并发运的费用会在报价中书面确认后再下单。
faq_items.question_en: Can I combine different products in one order or shipment?
faq_items.answer_en: Yes — different media and finished graphics can usually be combined into a single order, and where it makes sense they can be packed and shipped together. Send the full list with dimensions and quantities when you enquire; the combination, packing and freight for the combined shipment are confirmed in your quotation before you commit.

faq_items.answer_zh: 共六步：(1) 发送询价，注明产品、尺寸、数量和目的地；(2) 收到报价与形式发票（PI），规格、包装和运费均以书面确认；(3) 按 PI 通过电汇（T/T）付款；(4) 文件与规格确认后进入生产；(5) 发货前发送成品与出口包装照片供确认；(6) 按报价中确认的条款安排发运。
faq_items.question_en: How does ordering work, from enquiry to shipment?
faq_items.answer_en: In six steps: (1) send your enquiry with the product, dimensions, quantity and destination; (2) you receive a quotation and proforma invoice with the specifications, packing and freight confirmed in writing; (3) payment is made by bank transfer (T/T) against the proforma invoice; (4) production runs once files and specifications are confirmed; (5) before dispatch, you receive photos of the finished goods and their export packing for your confirmation; (6) the shipment is then arranged on the terms confirmed in your quotation.

faq_items.answer_zh: 把现有文件发过来即可，每个文件在生产前都会检查，有可能影响成品效果的问题会提前反馈确认。基本检查和简单调整包含在内；大幅修改或原创设计会事先单独报价，确认后再开始，不会产生意外费用。
faq_items.question_en: What do you need from my artwork files?
faq_items.answer_en: Send the artwork you have — every file is checked before production, and anything that could affect the printed result is flagged back to you first. Basic file checks and simple adjustments are included; larger revisions or original design work are quoted separately before any work starts, so there are no surprises in the total.
